name: Memberful
description: Memberful GraphQL API for paid newsletter and membership businesses. Query and manage members, subscriptions, plans/passes, prices, coupons, orders, downloads, and other account data supported by the connected Memberful account.

credential_fields.name: account_url
credential_fields.label: Memberful Account URL
credential_fields.description: Your Memberful account origin without a trailing slash, for example https://example.memberful.com.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: Custom Application API Key
credential_fields.description: Bearer API key from Settings > Custom applications in Memberful.

tools.name: build_checkout_url
tools.description: Build a Memberful-hosted checkout URL for a price. In Memberful's API terminology, the plan value is the dashboard Price ID. Optionally suggest a seat count for a group subscription.

plan.description: Memberful dashboard Price ID (called a Plan by the GraphQL API).

members.description: Optional suggested number of seats for a group subscription.

tools.name: graphql_request
tools.description: Execute any Memberful GraphQL query or mutation supported by the connected account. Use Memberful's in-dashboard GraphQL API Explorer for the live schema. This provides full coverage for members, subscriptions, passes (dashboard plans), plans (dashboard prices), coupons, orders, downloads, and other available objects.

query.description: GraphQL query or mutation document. Example: query { members(first: 20) { edges { node { id email fullName } } } }

operationName.description: Optional operation name when the document contains multiple operations.
